is_event.description: True if the post announces an upcoming event, false otherwise.

title.description: Title of the event extracted from caption or flyer.

time.description: Start time or time window (e.g. '8:00 PM - 9:30 PM').

campus.description: Rutgers campus: Busch, College Ave, Livingston, Cook/Doug, or Virtual / Online.

important_links.description: Any form links, registration URLs, Discord links, or 'link in bio'.

post_url.description: Direct URL to origin Instagram post.

image_url.description: URL to the scraped flyer/post photo.

video_url.description: URL to the scraped flyer/post video or reel.

flyer_details.description: Key event information, speakers, food, or instructions visible directly in the flyer graphic.
